changes: First catalog release: TRACK TRIG EDIT gains MICRO T under TRIGS (four-row window; REC.TRG scrolls into view).
LEVEL rewrites every step on the selected audio or MIDI track through the stock micro-timing writer.
MIDI button off writes the audio track; MIDI on writes the MIDI track and leaves the audio track alone.
The remembered MICRO T row lives with the module; a power cycle clears it so the row starts on grid again.
Offsets already written on the trigs stay in the pattern. Loads over USB as a usbOnly package.
